rows.en: I'm in charge of managing the quests, so I'm busy.
Tch!! Hey, Bear!! Even you can brew a cup of coffee, right?
ZZZ...
Gaah!! You're sleepin' again!? Hey, Ryuta!! You'll do. Coffee...
Ahahaha!! Drawing is so much fun~
When you can't find something, it's a good idea to retrace the places you've been through!
Hey, Bear!!
ZZzzz...
Aww, he's asleep again.
A Polymer Plaster Bomb? Huh, so you toss that into the Modified Bemstar's belly.
ZZZ... Hm? Toss... tears... TEARS...!!
You'll cry!!
Where is it!! Is it the enemy!! Is it my turn!!
Kin-chan!! Calm down!! No enemy's shown up!!
What? Don't go scarin' me like that. Well then, ZZZZZ...
Yapool modifies monsters and Choju to make them stronger and keeps them under his command...
If he's still alive, he might send out even stronger monsters.
Oh, so you met that Gundam. Did they say anything about us?
Huh? What's that, DG Cells? Hmm, what are they? I dunno~
Geez. This is why you're such a snot-nosed brat. Listen up. DG Cells means...
a (D)angerous, (G)reat hero like yours truly, that's what!
Hmm. ...I'm gonna get back to my drawing!
...Why, you!
Make sure you check the quest requests regularly, okay?
Huh? Believe it or not, I'm actually on the job right now.
This place sure is relaxing.
Shocker almost modified you, didn't they?
Yeah, it was a close shave.
Make yourself at home.
I might end up hanging around way too long, even with no business here.
Hey! We meet again! Huh? Even I take a break now and then, y'know?
Well then, time to go out and make some money!!
Hey, glad you came. Did the smell hook you? Actually, I tried whipping up a little snack.
It's fried chicken. Want to try some?
B... Bird!?
Don't you have anything else?
...Let's see. Ice pops are about all there is...
...!! You! Why didn't you say that first!?
Ice pops are fine with you?
Bring me every last one you've got!!
Make sure you check the quest requests regularly, okay?
Huh? Believe it or not, I'm actually on the job right now.
Make sure you check the quest requests regularly, okay?
Huh? Believe it or not, I'm actually on the job right now.
We've got more and more friends here at the base, huh.
Uh, Ultraman, Seven... Gaaaah! I already forgot!
How sloppy, Sempai. I've got them all memorized, you know?
Ultraman, Seven, Jack, Ace, and Zoffy.
Big talk... Then you go ahead and name every single Gundam!
...Well then, back to work, work.
Those are the five Ultra Brothers. Easy stuff.
What!? The "Ultra Cube" is frozen?
Don't tell me it's Todogiller's doing? His Freeze Shot gave me a rough time.
No, it must be Gander. That one nearly plunged Earth into an ice age.
Looks like we've both had our share of trouble with freezing attacks. Hahahahaha!!
Where do you suppose that Belial guy ran off to?
He said the "Monster Graveyard"?
Sounds like a creepy place.
Don't you go gettin' scared on me! Bear!
I don't wanna hear that from you, after yer legs gave out at the test of courage!!
Huh!? What'd you say!?
Well, anyway, it looks like we won't have to fight Belial for a while, so...
we can work out countermeasures in the meantime.
All right, if ya're prepared, there's nothin' to worry about! But before that...
I'll get some sleep. ...ZZZZZZZZ
Why're you goin' to sleep!!
Huh, so that Master Gundam guy is running the tournament.
...Yeah. Another Gundam.
There's way too many, no matter how ya slice it! Just how many Gundams are there!?
That makes nineteen.
You were countin'!?
...Geez, you are one hell of a Gundam nut!
...Thank you. That's the highest compliment.
Good grief...
...Give me a good cup of coffee.
Huh? Accel? Shouldn't you be resting in bed?
...W and the others are fighting. How could I just lie around sleeping...
...Accel!?

notes.note: Momotaros's mocking nickname for Kintaros (bear + mocking suffix) rendered 'Bear', parallel to 'Turtle' for Urataros (story_010). Ryuta = Ryutaros, as in story slices.
Ryutaros's affectionate nickname for Kintaros (bear + -chan) also rendered 'Bear'; honorific dropped per style. Not in glossary.
Pun: Kintaros half-asleep hears 'throw' (nageru) and slides to 'nakeru' = his catchphrase 'You'll cry'. Recreated as toss -> tears; Urataros's #0.122 uses 'toss' to set it up.
Which Gundam is not stated in the script; 'they' used (unknown gender).
Sentence runs on from #0.161 ('DG Cells means...'); cut at the same point. Source spells out the acronym with (D)/(G) in parentheses; kept that shape.
Same Talk01_03 pair as #0.25/#0.26 (talk_004, untranslated yet); #0.211/212 and #0.218/219 identical Japanese -> identical English.
Urataros to Rider 2, who was captured by Shocker in the story; kaizou = 'modified' (remodeling surgery). Shocker as 'they'.
Mis-decoded kanji for 'smell' (same glyph error as story #0314.111). Tsurareta = lured, rendered 'hook you' to keep Urataros's fishing motif.
Ankh is a bird Greeed, so 'bird' (not 'chicken') keeps the joke. Aisu = ice pops per Ankh's glossary note.
Freeze Shot = Todogiller skill name (SkillName.mbb). Kibishikatta rendered 'gave me a rough time'.
Seven. Gander spelled as in CharacterName.mbb / ChipLibMess (Ultraseven's ice kaiju, nearly froze Earth). Gander g not in glossary; 'That one' avoids a pronoun.
Urataros asking the party; subject 'he' = Belial (g=m) from #0.250.
Kintaros. Koshi wo nukasu at the test of courage (kimodameshi) = Momotaros's legs gave out in fright.
Sentence runs on into #0.257; cut at the same point.
Mis-decoded kanji in the proverb 'sonae areba urei nashi' (if you're prepared, no worries); read as that proverb.
Speaker shown as '???' in-game (Methuss before she appears); label not translated here, line only.

report: 80/80. Speakers from talkspk.py Quest (Urataros, Momotaros, Kintaros, Ryutaros, Rider 2, Birth, Ankh, Seven, 00, Accel; #0.279 '???' = Methuss). Uncertain: #0.123 pun recreated (toss->tears); #0.148 unnamed Gundam -> 'they'; #0.199/#0.258 mis-decoded kanji read from context. Not in glossary: 'Bear' (Momotaros's and Ryutaros's nicknames for Kintaros), Gander (taken from CharacterName.mbb), Freeze Shot (SkillName.mbb).
